analogy.rationale: Prostanoid receptor agonists act on Gs/Gq-coupled GPCRs (PTGER2/4, PTGIR, PTGFR, PTGDR) that are expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest reference classes are other prostanoid/GPCR ligands, though they act in the opposite direction or on distinct receptors.
